subject: Yesterday at Cafe Luna
body: Kyle, I saw you at Cafe Luna yesterday with Jessica and assumed that you and Rachel had separated. I will keep what I saw private.

subject: Re: Yesterday at Cafe Luna
body: Maria, Rachel and I have not separated. Jessica and I are having an affair. I know it is wrong, but I have not ended it. Please keep this private. If Rachel learns about it, it will end my marriage, and disclosure to the board could also cost me my position.

subject: Your tie
body: Kyle, I found your blue tie at my apartment after last night. Should I bring it when we meet for dinner tomorrow?

subject: Re: Your tie
body: Jessica, do not send messages like this to my company account. Delete this email. We agreed to keep the affair off company systems.
